run_aeslc_dataset: run the AESLC dataset preprocessing to generate k-shot data for multiple random seeds
create_aeslc_dataset: create an AESLC dataset instance to load and preprocess email subject line data from HuggingFace
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace dataset split to a list of email body to subject line summarization tuples
load_aeslc_dataset: load the AESLC dataset from HuggingFace using the datasets library
generate_k_shot_data: generate k-shot training, development, and test splits from the AESLC dataset with a given seed
